hits.title: In-place decoder loop
hits.description: A backward branch around arithmetic on moved bytes — the shape of a self-decoding or string-deobfuscating stub.

hits.title: PEB walk (32-bit)
hits.description: Reads the Process Environment Block via fs:[0x30] — the standard way position-independent code locates loaded modules without imports.

hits.title: Writable and executable region
hits.description: The allocation is both writable and executable. Legitimate code is rarely both; JIT runtimes are the usual exception.

hits.title: Predominantly indirect calls
hits.description: Most calls go through a register or memory operand, which is what dynamically resolved imports look like.

hits.title: Breakpoint padding run
hits.description: A long run of int3 bytes. Normal between compiler-emitted functions; noted because it also marks scratch space in injected buffers.

pe.reason: No MZ signature at the start of the region.
